client.name: Sonic Robo Blast 2 Client
client._kind_source: README: "there will be an option labeled Sonic Robo Blast 2 Client" in the Archipelago launcher, and "SRB2 will automatically open with the AP mod loaded". The world drives the game itself.
client._protocol_source: the world opens its own connection to the game -- no emulator memory protocol is involved, so London carries nothing but the launch. Recorded as "self" rather than naming a bridge we do not use.

apworld._source: README names that releases page; latest v1.7.3 carries srb2.apworld

_install_kind_source: README lists three pieces: srb2.apworld into custom_worlds, SL_ArchipelagoSRB2_Vxxx.pk3 into SRB2's addons folder, and an EMPTY file named APTranslator.dat created by hand in luafiles/archipelago/. London can carry the apworld; the other two are the player's and the card must not claim otherwise.
setup: Download srb2.apworld and SL_ArchipelagoSRB2_Vxxx.pk3 from the release.
Put srb2.apworld in Archipelago's custom_worlds folder.
Move the .pk3 into your SRB2 installation's addons folder.
In your SRB2 directory create luafiles/archipelago/ and an empty APTranslator.dat inside it.
Start the Sonic Robo Blast 2 Client from the Archipelago launcher.

patch._source: the setup guide describes no patching step

_patch_extension_source: world source not downloaded -- repo policy is addresses only. Flagged in every build until somebody reads it.
